_comment: Recipes of the stage-2 production area (prefix prod).

Building records: 15 x 40 bytes at 0x455849 + 40*i (i = plot index: 0 reception, 1 cutting, 2 sound, 3 copier, 4 studio 1, 5 marketing, 6 warehouse, 7 office, 8 Lula's flat, 9 movie planning, 10 props, 11 casting, 12 recreation, 13 studio 2, 14 studio 3);

+0 monthly rent, +4 price, +8 n, +0xc price with money-back guarantee (price * (1 + 1/n)), +0x10 = 1 rented or owned, +0x14 = 1 bought, +0x18 = 1 bought with guarantee, +0x1c/+0x20/+0x24 day, month, year of the deal.

prod_s2slow.note: stage2 with a slow clock (0x4556bc = 30: 31 timer calls per game minute instead of 4), so that no hourly event (the 13:00 sabotage roll of 0x43070e, which shows an info box) fires while the prod_s2all script rents the buildings.

prod_s2all.note: stage2 with all 13 production buildings rented by the game at the realtor (every building but Lula's flat), saved by the game on the WET plot (room 20, not realtor mode) as 'ProdAll' in slot 4; then account 1500000 (2000000 or more ends stage 2 at the next day end, 0x40528b), clock 8:00 and the normal game speed (0x4556bc = 3).

prod_s2staff.note: prod_s2all with one employee per job patched into the staff table that follows the guest block in SAVEGAME (record i of [0x455348] = 553 records of 40 bytes at file offset 0x7b8d + 40*i, written here as the pseudo address 0x45d1ad + 40*i; +0 job 0-21 = strings 912-933, +4 status: 0 free, 1 hired and idle, 2 hired and working in its department, 3 in training, 4 applicant, 5 sick; +0xc level, +0x10 pay per day). Status 2 (what the hire code 0x41c9ad gives the first employee of a job) for jobs 1-3, 5-11 and 13-19; status 1 (what it gives the studio crew and actors) for lighting engineer 164, cameraman 230, director 377, actor 527 and actress 17. The check also asserts the job of each patched record. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'ProdAll' (300,119).
